name: Lion's Heart
title: For the caregivers nobody sees 🦁
quote: There's a friend who drives three hours just to sit and hold a hand.
first: There's a husband learning how to cook
last: In the middle of the night

name: Lion's Heart
title: For the ones who went on ahead. You were lions too. 🕊️
quote: It was never 'bout how long you stayed. It's the love you gave away.
first: And to the ones who went on ahead
last: And the whole world is singing for you

name: A Mile An Hour
title: I rang that bell three times, then learned to walk again 🔔
quote: Ain't nobody passin' me but the leaves in the breeze.
first: They pumped that poison down into my chest
last: Ain't nobody passin' me but the leaves in the breeze

name: A Mile An Hour
title: Who's worth going through hell for? Find 'em. Hold 'em close. 🛣️
quote: So nobody walkin' slow has to walk alone.
first: Yeah, I'm walkin' this road at a mile an hour (mile an hour)
last: Still walkin' on...

name: Beautiful Anyway
title: Holding the hand that once carried the whole world 🕯️
quote: They never saw the fire you carried inside.
first: The coffee's gone cold and the window is gray
last: They never saw the fire you carried inside

name: Beautiful Anyway
title: Say I love you every chance you get ❤️
quote: I'd rather say too much than nothing at all.
first: I learned it the hard way, in rooms just like these
last: Go hold them too long... anyway

name: Take a Number
title: Death asked if I was tired yet. Tired ain't the same as giving up. 🤠
quote: Then my mama walked in, eyes red but standing tall.
first: He came back Tuesday when the treatment hit hard
last: So take a number, take a seat

name: Take a Number
title: By the second winter, Death started bringing me coffee ☕
quote: Don't wait to start your living. The living's right here.
first: By the second winter he quit bringing the clipboard
last: Don't wait to start your living, friend, the living's right here

name: Living in the Echo
title: It's just a blood test. My body doesn't believe it.
quote: Like my body knows this building, and it's bracing for what's to come.
first: It's only a simple check, just some lab work, nothing more
last: Four years clear, and it's ringing just as strong

name: Living in the Echo
title: For the survivors everybody thinks are fine 💙
quote: Go easy on your people. There's a lot you'll never know.
first: This song is for the survivors everybody thinks are fine
last: Four years clear, and it's ringing just as strong

name: Light One, Let It Go
title: There was a season I could barely lift a spoon 🏮
quote: So I sit at the table with a pencil and fold every prayer into a song.
first: Mornings come slower than they used to
last: Light one, let it go

name: Light One, Let It Go
title: Write the words you wish somebody told you on your hardest night ✍️
quote: It doesn't have to be pretty, and it doesn't have to rhyme.
first: So if you're holding one tonight, here's the only thing I ask
last: Long after the flame

name: Remember Me When I'm Gone
title: This body was only ever leased 🕊️
quote: I gave it back a little worn, but I left it here in peace.
first: This body that I lived in
last: To fill up every space

name: Remember Me When I'm Gone
title: For anyone missing someone tonight 🕊️
quote: I'm closer than you think I am. I was never very far.
first: Maybe I'm your father, maybe I'm your friend
last: I'm never really gone

name: Floor of Shadows
title: Every time I ride that elevator up to the fourth floor
quote: I'm wearing the clothes of a normal man, walking in like nothing's strange.
first: I take the elevator up
last: On a floor I know by heart

name: Floor of Shadows
title: To every oncology nurse: I saw what you carried 💙
quote: The nurses did the best they could at a job I couldn't do.
first: I've done hours in those chairs, and I've done nights in those beds
last: Carrying a weight I never knew every time they left that floor

name: No Complaints
title: Here's why I always ask how you're doing 😉
quote: Their mind goes looking for something good to tell me. And it finds it.
first: People ask me, "How we doing?"
last: You're welcome

name: No Complaints
title: Nine out of ten stopped calling. The one who stayed was worth it all.
quote: The one in ten shows up when it's ugly, and that one's worth it all.
first: Nine out of ten of the names that used to call me don't call at all
last: So I pour it all out in my notes, all the thoughts I couldn't keep

name: Even If We Stumble
hook: They say it's bad for me.
title: They say it's bad for my body. It's the reason I'm still alive. 💉
quote: A little door above my heart to let you in.
first: They don't understand what we've got going on
last: 'Cause I'm waking up each morning, and that's the deal we made

name: Even If We Stumble
title: A love song with a twist ending. Wait for it. 💉
quote: Thank you, nurse. Same time in two weeks.
first: Even if we stumble, even if we fall
last: Same time in two weeks

name: My Word Won't Die
title: They counted my days. So I made the days count.
quote: If I say it, I'll back it. Every step on the ground.
first: Never been one for talking
last: Is the word I'm living out

name: My Word Won't Die
hook: in my feet. Not my word.
title: Chemo took the feeling in my feet. Not my word.
quote: I gotta be ten times stronger 'cause I'm ten times weak.
first: The treatment left its mark on me
last: 'Cause you're welcome to come in

name: Island Time
title: I asked the chemo nurse for a pineapple and an umbrella in my cup 🍍
quote: Every single morning that I open up my eyes is a little piece of paradise.
first: Back in that treatment chair, I close my eyes and see
last: Counting days in smiles

name: Island Time
title: No glass, no screen, no distance. Just my arms around them 🌺
quote: If I hold you a little longer than you think I should, it's 'cause I remember when I couldn't.
first: There was a season I could only wave hello
last: That's the kind of rich that's worth the keeping

name: Unfinished
title: We trade "I'm fine" like a password
quote: The one who's always smiling might be the one who's breaking too.
tags: it's okay to not be okay
first: Now I see it in the checkout line
last: So I'm giving them away

name: Unfinished
hook: while there's ink in the pen.
title: Nobody's book is finished while there's ink left in the pen 🖋️
quote: Write the nights you come apart and the mornings you come through.
first: So here's the pen, it's yours too
last: Me and you

name: Only The Strong Survive
hook: My body can't do a stage.
title: My body can't do a stage. So your headphones are my stadium tonight 🎧
quote: So I put it in a song, and I wrote it on the page.
first: Then they told me, "You should hear yourself
last: Now your speakers and headphones are my stadium tonight

name: Only The Strong Survive
title: To the ones we've lost: passing never made you weak 🕊️
quote: Passing never made you weak. It made you human, friend.
first: To the ones we've lost along the way
last: And the courage to be real

name: Dying to Live
title: You told me the odds were unbeatable. You never told me I was unbreakable.
quote: Quit staring at the clock, and I started digging roots.
first: You told me the odds were unbeatable
last: I was living to die, now I'm dying to live

name: Dying to Live
title: If you're counting down instead of on, make one promise ✊
quote: Don't promise them forever. Just promise them you'll fight it every day you've got.
first: So if you're sitting where I sat, counting down instead of on
last: So I never said I'd beat it, I just swore I'd fight it through

name: I Live On Through You
title: The sun is going down, but it's coming up soon 🌅
quote: Just a whole life's worth of living that I'm passing down.
first: I got a ticket for a sweet afternoon
last: I live on through you

name: I Live On Through You
hook: Pull a chair up by the bed
title: Show up for each other. Pull a chair up by the bed and stay. 🪑
quote: Keep your circle small and tight, and let the good ones in.
first: Don't you waste a single minute crying at the gate
last: I live on through you

name: A Seat at the Table
title: This one's for the fathers, those beside us and those gone 🥃
quote: A real man is the shelter, not the storm.
first: Now this one's for the fathers, the ones who showed us how
last: So we'll sing for 'em together for as long as we are able

name: A Seat at the Table
title: A blessing for whoever needs it tonight 🍀
quote: May the ones you've lost sit with you in the stories that you tell.
first: May your cup be full of something good, whatever suits you best
last: So we'll sing for 'em together for as long as we are able

name: Live Now, Die Later
title: I used to think crying made me weaker than a man should be 🎭
quote: Now when I need to, I just cry, and I let it have its say.
first: I used to fight back every tear, bury it where none could see
last: Feel the whole thing through

name: Live Now, Die Later
title: If you're carrying a lot tonight, let it out 🎭
quote: Nobody gets to tell you how you're supposed to feel.
first: If you found this song tonight, and you're carrying a lot
last: Feel the whole thing through

name: Embrace Every Scar
title: My bicep tore and rolled up like a window shade. Pride's receipt. 💪
quote: Some scars teach you what you're made of, some teach you what you're not.
first: There's another on my right forearm, and it's got a story too
last: The pain is just proof you're alive

name: Embrace Every Scar
hook: are the ones I wear most.
title: The scars nobody sees are the ones I wear the most
quote: We can both put the smile down for a minute, and that's alright.
first: But the ones nobody sees are the ones I wear the most
last: It don't matter where you got 'em, you're allowed to heal again

name: Make Your Time Count
title: Sit down, kid. Here's what I wish I'd known. 🎺
quote: Everybody shows up for the party. Watch how quick you lose the crowd.
first: Sit down, kid, I see that worry
last: Then who had excuses ready when the hard news came and went

name: Make Your Time Count
hook: Turn the devil into a thief.
title: Laugh through the cancer and turn the devil into a thief 😄
quote: All the love you've got for these words is the same love I've got for you.
first: In the hardest rooms I've sat in, I found out that laughter's free
last: All the love you've got for these words is the same love I've got for you

name: Shout Yes
title: Yes doesn't mean I like it. It means I'm here for it. 🙌
quote: I've never had a morning yet I couldn't put a yes on.
first: Now I stand up slow on gummy legs and find my balance first
last: Say it with me

name: Shout Yes
title: If all you've got today is a whispered yes, that's enough 🙌
quote: Some days you say it till you mean it, and that's how you start the day.
first: Maybe you're grieving, maybe you're hurting, maybe your mind won't let you rest
last: Just don't you dare surrender to the down inside

name: From Where I Stand
title: For years they said it was probably nothing. Then: stage four.
quote: I was almost relieved. At least now we know where to begin.
first: For years, every answer was the same
last: Now we've got a fight and a way through

name: From Where I Stand
title: Every time they looked at me, I gave them calm instead of fear
quote: That was the only wheel I had, so that's the one I steered.
first: I couldn't stop the cancer or the things that chemo took
last: Still standing, here I am

name: Quiet Fire
hook: So I picked up a pen.
title: My hands couldn't haul the load anymore, so I picked up a pen ✍️
quote: My body's got a fence line, but my mind's got none.
first: These old hands can't haul the load they hauled back then
last: But everybody feels the spark

name: Quiet Fire
title: The kind of people who show up in the rain without being asked twice
quote: With a casserole, a jumper cable, and some good advice.
first: I don't need a stadium, I don't need a crowd
last: But in the quiet's where the truth gets told

name: Footprints of Gold
hook: to hear what you don't say.
title: My daddy taught me to hear what people can't find the words to say
quote: When somebody says they're alright and looks away, I pull up close and stay.
first: Oh, my daddy taught me something that I hold on to today
last: He truly lived for others, the realest good man you could meet

name: Footprints of Gold
title: Call the friend who's gone too quiet ☎️
quote: Help somebody move a couch. Pay for the car behind you.
first: So here's something you can do before the sun goes down today
last: Every little kindness leaves a step that glows

name: We Die Before We Quit
title: I looked around the waiting room and saw the little kids
quote: Give me the sickness, give me the weakness.
first: I look around the waiting room, I see the little kids
last: Refusing defeat, completing the treatment

name: We Die Before We Quit
title: Stage four tried to take it all. I looked it in the eyes. 🥊
quote: I am the director of a resurrection.
first: The monitors were my lifestyle
last: Defying every medical conjecture
